control.learner: exact fixed shallow HistGradientBoostingRegressor from PR31/PR34
control.chronology: exact PR31/PR34 folds, +1 entry delay, 20-session path hold, and purge

challenger.representation: control plus exact six features from the SHA-pinned PR45 first-print cache
challenger.daily_join: for a signal timestamp, use only the latest cache row with available_from <= signal calendar date
challenger.missing_policy: drop rows lacking a complete frozen cycle vector; re-evaluate control on the exact same rows

learner_policy: same fixed HGB for control and challenger; no hyperparameter, target, feature, threshold, cost, duration, or model-family sweep
interpretation: each path head independently earns or rejects cycle information; a passing head does not alter admission/ranking/duration or force this representation into other heads
